'''Domoru Krev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] warlord who lived at some point before the end of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Domoru Krev soldier|soldiers]] who served Lord Krev were known to wear [[lanvarok]] gauntlets on their left [[Limb/Legends|arms]].<ref name="BOS" />
